mg.title: Feelings people have

text.main: a machine doesn't have the feelings that people do.

mg.use: Only if you add this line to the cut, right after “compassion”. Never over a name super.

mg.title: A human head

text.main: We want a human head controlling this powerful machine.

mg.use: Over Nich on the panel as he says it. Top third, away from his name super. Keep captions on.

mg.title: Push through

text.main: being able to push through things that are hard.

mg.use: Full-frame cutaway on her words to hide a pause cut. Only after her name super is gone.

mg.title: An answer quickly

text.main: you can get an answer really quickly.

mg.use: Full-frame cutaway on her words, in place of the C0181 cover if the shot is weak.

mg.title: Not an easy answer

text.main: work through something where there's not an easy answer

mg.use: Over Kate as she says it. Keep captions on.

mg.title: Focus on Kate
mg.use: Brackets on Kate as she uses her hand at 01:18. Not at the same time as MG 5.

mg.title: Follow them

text.main: So let's go with them, let's follow them

mg.use: On her words over the panel shot.

mg.title: Safe, ethical, critical
mg.use: Each line lands on her word, in the top band. Keep captions on.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: NFTE logo. Nothing else. L012C008 (2 s of the buildings at dusk) under the NFTE end card.
